name: x-dm
description: Audit X/Twitter outreach history, validate DM availability, and send one explicitly approved DM at a time with campaign tracking, deduplication, caps, locking, and hard browser timeouts.

X_COOKIES.prompt: Paste your X/Twitter cookies as a JSON array, Netscape cookies.txt, or raw Cookie header. If empty, the tool tries the chat's x-session-reader cookies.

CHROME_EXECUTABLE_PATH.prompt: Optional Chrome/Chromium executable path. Defaults to Playwright's cached Chromium.

HEADLESS.prompt: Run browser headless: true or false.

MIN_SECONDS_BETWEEN_SENDS.prompt: Minimum seconds between actual DM sends.

EXPECTED_ACCOUNT_HANDLE.prompt: Optional X handle guard. Sending is blocked if a different logged-in handle is detected.

MAX_SENDS_PER_DAY.prompt: Maximum confirmed X DMs per UTC day across all campaigns.

OPERATION_TIMEOUT_MS.prompt: Maximum browser operation time in milliseconds, clamped between 30000 and 180000.

MAX_SENDS_PER_CAMPAIGN_PER_DAY.prompt: Maximum confirmed X DMs per UTC day for one campaign.
